{{Top|leg}}
The '''Military Arms Regulatory Bureau''' was an agency with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that existed by the years following the [[Old Sith Wars]]. It was a determining body that licensed the use of special [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to private owners that were deemed too sophisticated and dangerous for full scale sales. The [[Devastator war droid]] developed by [[Ubrikkian Steamworks]] was deemed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] designates for being such a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with any individual or organization wanting to purchase them requiring the necessary permit from the Military Arms Regulatory Bureau. Their actions resulted in a severe cut in profits for Ubrikkian Steamworks who cut production of the war droid as soon as it began due to this restriction.
